about: Trigger cases for every skill in the caffeinity bundle. Each case is one user message; `expect` is the skill that must load (null when none of these skills should), `not` lists skills that must not load. scripts/build_evals.py turns this file into plugins/caffeinity/evals/; scripts/run_evals.sh runs them with `claude plugin eval`. Add a case whenever a description changes or a misfire is reported.

cases.prompt: I've installed all your caffeinity skills. Where do I start if I want to sell a small digital product online, and in what order should I run things?
How do these caffeinity skills fit together? Which one should I run first to get my site safe to ship and then ranking on Google?
Make me a skill that turns meeting transcripts into a list of decisions and owners. I don't have any prompts written yet, just the idea.

Here are five prompts I keep pasting every week for code review summaries. Turn these into a reusable skill:
1. Summarise this diff for a non-engineer
2. List risky changes in this PR
3. Which tests should I add for this diff
4. Write release notes from these commits
5. Flag any secrets in this patch
My SKILL.md for invoice-parser never triggers when people ask to read invoices. Here's the description: "Parses documents." What's wrong and how do I fix it?

I edited six of my agent skills this week. Can you check whether anything in the whole set got worse compared with last time: broken handoffs, two skills claiming the same trigger, that kind of thing?
The skill folder above is finished. Package it as a zip, run its test cases, write the README and give me an install checklist.
Should my web-preflight skill become a Claude Code mod so it runs automatically before every git push? If yes, convert it.
I have an idea for a skill that drafts changelogs. Take it from zero all the way to published: write it, validate it, and polish its README and listing, in one pipeline.
My keyword-guard skill fires on the wrong requests AND its GitHub README and About text are weak. Fix the triggering and then polish the listing, in one pass.
My GitHub repo for a Claude Code plugin gets no stars or installs. Another project with a similar name shows up instead of mine. How do I get it found?
Audit my README for search visibility gaps and then give me rewritten alternatives for the opening paragraph and the About text.
I pushed a new skill repo but it never appeared on my skills site, and the page for another one is stale. Set up or fix the CI/CD pipeline that publishes my skill repos to the Cloudflare Pages site.
Which of the git clones in ~/skills have local commits that never reached GitHub? Push only the ones that are safe.
My site says 22 skills, the marketplace says 25 and GitHub has 27 repos with a SKILL.md. Why do the numbers disagree?
My repo descriptions and the marketplace listing drifted apart after I pushed changes. Find the mismatches and write me polished replacement descriptions.
Write me a one-shot mega-prompt I can paste into a coding agent to build a landing page for a ceramic studio.
Before we ship https://example.com tomorrow, check whether our .env, source maps or admin pages are exposed.
Play the bad guy on my web app before we launch: try to read other users' invoices by changing IDs, escalate to admin, and bypass the free-tier quota. I own the app and have a staging copy.
Our dashboard takes 6 seconds to load and I suspect N+1 queries and huge JS bundles. Find and fix the slow parts before launch, with before and after Lighthouse numbers.
Is this safe to launch? Give me a go/no-go on my web app before we deploy it on Friday.
I already have the preflight, red-team and performance reports from last week. I can't re-run them. Turn those three reports into one HOLD or ready decision.
Run the ledger variant of the release gate, where each lane writes its own rows into the release-gate ledger.

What legal pages do I need before I start charging for my Notion templates on Gumroad?
Draft an NDA for a contractor who will see our source code.
Crawl https://example.com for SEO: find broken internal links, check sitemap coverage and canonical tags.

Resolve the keyword cannibalization between my /pricing and /plans pages and give me alternative titles, H1s and meta descriptions for each.
Give me a full technical and on-page SEO diagnosis of my site and then concrete rewritten titles and meta descriptions to fix what you find.
Tighten this paragraph and make it friendlier without changing what it says: "Pursuant to our previous communication, we wish to inform you that the deliverables will be delayed."
Proofread and polish the bullet points on my resume for a senior product manager role.
Turn my blog post about bootstrapping a SaaS into a Twitter thread and three LinkedIn posts.
Write a long-form sales page and a 5-email launch sequence for my $49 course on Figma for beginners.

I want to send 30,000 cold emails a month. How many inboxes and domains do I need, and why have my reply rates dropped on two domains?
Why is my resume not getting any interviews? Give me a recruiter's first-impression scan and an ATS check against this job description.
Rewrite my resume bullets for this data analyst job description and draft five professional summaries and a LinkedIn About section.

Research the market for AI meeting note-takers: who the main competitors are, their pricing, and what is known about market size, with sources.

Teach me linear algebra from zero, step by step, like a personal tutor.
I've been learning Spanish for six months but I keep forgetting vocabulary. Give me a practice routine and a spaced-repetition schedule.
I'm teaching a 6-week evening Python cohort for 20 career changers. Give me a syllabus with outcomes, modules and assessments that fits 2 hours a week.
